title: Asassato loko
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati Asassato loko ti || || 3 Bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā || || 4-13 Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati || pa || Viññāṇaṃ niccam aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || pa || || Api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya Asassato loko ti || || No hetam bhante || || 14 Yam pi diṭṭhaṃ sutam mutaṃ viññātam pattam pariyesitam anuvicaritam manasā tam pi niccaṃ va aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccam bhante || || Dukkham vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya Asassato loko ti || || No hetam bhante || || 15 Yato ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa || || pe || || niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
